repos_data.description: Live, on-device transcription of any app on your Mac, with speaker names.

Free, open-source, surround bit-perfect music player for Mac. Switches your DAC to every track's native format, plays DSD, Dolby Atmos, TrueHD and DTS, renders surround as Spatial Audio on AirPods, and catches fake hi-res files.

Be present. Reprise remembers. An open-source call recorder for macOS: it notices calls in Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime and more, and records both sides at about 1% CPU, and the screen if you want, to plain files. It keeps the call through a lost mic, a new headset or a crash. Native Swift, no dependencies, MIT.
Free pitch shifter for Mac: change the pitch of Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube or any app, live, without changing the tempo. Menu-bar app, macOS 14.4+.
